context_requirements: Functional cholinergic synaptic machinery for canonical acetylcholine release enhancement
Expression of MAOA/MAOB if monoamine oxidase inhibition contributes to the mechanism
Neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage for a robust transcriptional response
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that matches known MAO inhibitor or cholinergic pathway activation signatures
Enrichment of MAOA/MAOB-dependent gene sets after treatment

changes: No gene lists were provided, so no direction, specificity, or duplicate-list corrections were possible.

Mechanism is internally inconsistent: acetylcholine release enhancement is a presynaptic/neuronal function, while the listed primary targets MAOA/MAOB are monoamine oxidases, not acetylcholine release proteins; the target assignment should be reconsidered or removed.

None of the nine cell lines (A375, A549, HA1E, HCC515, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7, PC3, VCAP) are neuronal or cholinergic; all line_response entries of 'none' are therefore appropriate, but the context requirement for neuronal lineage makes the model untestable in this panel.

Kinetics and magnitude are listed as 'none'; this is acceptable only if no transcriptional response is expected, but it conflicts with the falsifiers that anticipate measurable changes at 6 h and 24 h.
Evidence list is empty; no citations were available to verify, so no evidence corrections were made.
